ideas.title: Investigating ICE Shootings
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the use of force by ICE agents and the impact on communities
questions: What are the protocols for use of force by ICE agents?
How many incidents of ICE shootings have occurred in the past year?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a critical issue that affects many communities. By investigating the use of force by ICE agents and the impact on communities, we can hold those in power accountable and push for greater transparency and oversight.

ideas.title: The Impact of Child Care Assistance Cuts
ideas.description: An examination of the effects of cuts to child care assistance on families and communities
questions: How many families have been affected by the cuts to child care assistance?
What are the long-term effects of these cuts on children and families?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight the human impact of cuts to social services and benefits. By examining the effects of these cuts on families and communities, we can better understand the need for greater investment in these programs and the importance of protecting vulnerable populations.
